ADA BEACH SURFERS is our first project comprised of 1,000 randomly generated NFTs with 90+ original traits. Minting will not only secure you a rad PFP but an airdrop of ADA BEACH’s next project: ADA BEACH WAVES. Minting surfers will not only secure you a rad PFP but an airdrop of ADA BEACH’s next project.
